entry.en: The passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date of arrival in Samoa.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Samoa.
entry.quote: To enter Samoa, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Border officials issue a free visitor permit using your arrival card.
entry.es: Los funcionarios de frontera emiten un permiso de visitante gratuito usando la tarjeta de llegada.
entry.quote: Border officials will issue a free visitor permit or business visitor permit using your arrival card.

entry.en: Visa-free entry assumes an onward or return ticket out of Samoa and a bank statement showing sufficient funds.
entry.es: La entrada sin visa supone contar con un billete de salida o regreso y un extracto bancario que pruebe fondos suficientes.
entry.quote: an onward or return ticket out of Samoa and a bank statement with proof of sufficient funds to cover their stay

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se viene de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Samoa, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 20,000 talas or more must be declared.
entry.es: Hay que declarar efectivo o cheques de viajero por 20.000 tala o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 20,000 talas or more.

entry.en: Flying from Samoa to American Samoa requires paying a departure tax of 40 Samoan tala.
entry.es: Volar de Samoa a Samoa Americana exige pagar una tasa de salida de 40 tala samoanos.
entry.quote: If you are flying from Samoa to American Samoa, you must pay a departure tax of 40 Samoan tala.

safety.en: The level of serious crime is low and petty theft is uncommon and opportunistic.
safety.es: El nivel de delitos graves es bajo y los hurtos son poco comunes y oportunistas.
safety.quote: The level of serious crime is low, and incidents of petty theft are uncommon and opportunistic.

safety.en: Samoa is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, where earthquakes and tremors are a constant risk.
safety.es: Samoa forma parte del Cinturón de Fuego del Pacífico, donde los terremotos y temblores son un riesgo constante.
safety.quote: Samoa is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, an active zone where earthquakes and tremors are a constant risk.

safety.en: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to the end of April, with most rain from December to March.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones tropicales suele ir de noviembre a fines de abril, con más lluvia de diciembre a marzo.
safety.quote: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to the end of April, but most rain falls from December to March.

safety.en: Tides can produce powerful currents in ocean lagoons, so take local advice before swimming.
safety.es: Las mareas pueden producir corrientes fuertes en las lagunas oceánicas, así que conviene pedir consejo local antes de nadar.
safety.quote: Samoa’s tides can produce powerful currents in ocean lagoons. Take local advice before swimming.

safety.en: Stray dogs are common in Apia and many villages and can become aggressive if approached or threatened.
safety.es: Los perros callejeros abundan en Apia y en muchas aldeas y pueden volverse agresivos si se les acerca o se sienten amenazados.
safety.quote: Stray dogs are common in Apia and in many villages. They can become aggressive if you approach them or if they feel threatened.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Samoa and same-sex marriage is not recognised.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en Samoa y el matrimonio homosexual no se reconoce.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Samoa and same-sex marriage is not recognised.

health.en: Samoa is malaria-free, but dengue fever and chikungunya outbreaks occasionally occur.
health.es: Samoa está libre de malaria, pero ocurren brotes ocasionales de dengue y chikungunya.
health.quote: Samoa is a malaria-free zone. However, there are occasional outbreaks of dengue fever and (since 2014) chikungunya

health.en: Drinking bottled water is advised, as it is cheap and readily available.
health.es: Se aconseja beber agua embotellada, que es barata y fácil de conseguir.
health.quote: Drink bottled water. It's cheap and readily available.

health.en: In a medical emergency, evacuation to Australia, New Zealand or Hawaii is likely to be the only treatment option.
health.es: En una emergencia médica, la evacuación a Australia, Nueva Zelanda o Hawái probablemente sea la única opción de tratamiento.
health.quote: If you have a medical emergency, evacuation to Australia, New Zealand or Hawaii is likely to be the only option for treatment.

health.en: There are two hospitals in Apia and one on Savaii at Tuasivi.
health.es: Hay dos hospitales en Apia y uno en Savaii, en Tuasivi.
health.quote: There are two hospitals in Apia and one on Savaii at Tuasivi

health.en: In the water, beware of purple cone shells, sea urchins and fire coral.
health.es: En el agua hay que cuidarse de los caracoles cono, erizos de mar y coral de fuego.
health.quote: In the water beware of purple cone shells, sea urchins, fire coral, etc.

health.en: Some travellers have reported a violent allergic reaction to the ceremonial drink kava.
health.es: Algunos viajeros han informado de una reacción alérgica violenta a la bebida ceremonial kava.
health.quote: Some travellers have reported a violent allergic reaction to the ceremonial drink kava.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

getting_in.en: The main international airport, Faleolo (APW), is about a 45-minute drive from Apia.
getting_in.es: El principal aeropuerto internacional, Faleolo (APW), está a unos 45 minutos en coche de Apia.
getting_in.quote: The main international airport, Faleolo (APW IATA), is approximately a 45-minute drive from Apia.

getting_in.en: Air New Zealand provides six flights per week from Auckland.
getting_in.es: Air New Zealand ofrece seis vuelos por semana desde Auckland.
getting_in.quote: Air New Zealand provides six flights per week from Auckland.

getting_in.en: Fiji Airways has three flights a week from Nadi and one a week from Honolulu.
getting_in.es: Fiji Airways tiene tres vuelos semanales desde Nadi y uno semanal desde Honolulu.
getting_in.quote: Fiji Airways has three flights a week from Nadi in Fiji, and one a week from Honolulu.

getting_in.en: There is a weekly ferry from Pago Pago in American Samoa.
getting_in.es: Hay un ferri semanal desde Pago Pago, en Samoa Americana.
getting_in.quote: There is a weekly ferry from Pago Pago in neighbouring American Samoa.

getting_in.en: The MV Tokelau connects Apia Harbour with Tokelau twice a month.
getting_in.es: El MV Tokelau conecta el puerto de Apia con Tokelau dos veces al mes.
getting_in.quote: A twice-monthly service by the MV Tokelau connects Apia Harbour with Tokelau.

getting_in.en: Visiting yachts must arrive in Apia and contact the Samoa Port Authority at least two days before arrival to arrange clearances.
getting_in.es: Los veleros visitantes deben llegar a Apia y contactar a la Autoridad Portuaria de Samoa al menos dos días antes para gestionar los trámites.
getting_in.quote: Visiting boats must arrive in Apia and should contact the Samoa Port Authority at least two days before ETA to arrange necessary clearances on arrival.

getting_around.en: Traffic in Samoa drives on the left.
getting_around.es: En Samoa se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Traffic in Samoa drives on the left.

getting_around.en: The speed limit is 40kmph in towns and villages and 56kmph outside.
getting_around.es: El límite de velocidad es de 40 km/h en pueblos y aldeas y de 56 km/h fuera de ellos.
getting_around.quote: The speed limit is 40kmph in towns and villages and 56kmph outside.

getting_around.en: International driving licences are not accepted, so a temporary local licence is needed.
getting_around.es: No se aceptan licencias de conducir internacionales, por lo que se necesita una licencia local temporal.
getting_around.quote: As international driving licences are not accepted you need to obtain a temporary local licence.

getting_around.en: Taxis are cheap and plentiful, but agree on a price in advance because they may overcharge people who look rich.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son baratos y abundantes, pero conviene acordar el precio antes porque pueden cobrar de más a quien parezca rico.
getting_around.quote: Do agree on a price in advance; if they think you look rich they may try to overcharge you.

getting_around.en: Buses on Upolu fan out from two locations in Apia, near the main market and behind the flea market.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses de Upolu parten de dos puntos de Apia, cerca del mercado principal y detrás del mercado de pulgas.
getting_around.quote: Buses on Upolu fan out from two locations in Apia, close to the main market and behind the flea market.

getting_around.en: Driving at night should be avoided as roads are poorly lit and any hazards make driving very dangerous.
getting_around.es: Se debe evitar conducir de noche porque las carreteras están mal iluminadas y cualquier peligro vuelve la conducción muy peligrosa.
getting_around.quote: Avoid driving at night as roads are poorly lit and any hazards make driving very dangerous.

money.en: The currency is the Samoan tālā (WST).
money.es: La moneda es el tālā samoano (WST).
money.quote: The currency is the Samoan tālā, denoted as "WS$, "T", "ST" or "SAT" (ISO currency code: WST).

money.en: Local laws make it illegal to do business in a foreign currency.
money.es: Las leyes locales hacen ilegal hacer negocios en moneda extranjera.
money.quote: Local laws make it illegal to carry out business in a foreign currency.

money.en: Haggling is not customary and is considered rude.
money.es: Regatear no es costumbre y se considera de mala educación.
money.quote: Haggling is not customary and is in fact considered rude.

money.en: Tipping is not practiced or expected in Samoa.
money.es: En Samoa no se acostumbra ni se espera dar propina.
money.quote: Tipping is not practiced or expected in Samoa.

money.en: Samoa is relatively inexpensive for western visitors.
money.es: Samoa es relativamente barata para visitantes occidentales.
money.quote: Samoa is relatively inexpensive for western visitors.

etiquette.en: Sunday is generally respected as a holy day and one should not walk through villages on Sundays.
etiquette.es: El domingo se respeta como día sagrado y no se debe caminar por las aldeas en domingo.
etiquette.quote: Sunday is generally respected as a holy day and most shops and businesses are closed. You should not walk through villages on Sundays.

etiquette.en: Many villages have a prayer curfew at sundown lasting around half an hour.
etiquette.es: Muchas aldeas tienen un toque de queda de oración al atardecer que dura cerca de media hora.
etiquette.quote: Many villages have a prayer curfew in place at sundown. This normally lasts around half an hour.

etiquette.en: It is wise to avoid revealing clothing and to follow village rules enforced by the village matai (chiefs).
etiquette.es: Es prudente evitar ropa reveladora y cumplir las reglas de la aldea que hacen cumplir los matai (jefes).
etiquette.quote: it is wise to avoid revealing clothing and to comply with village rules which are enforced by the village matai (chiefs)

etiquette.en: Women going topless is taboo, swimwear is only for the beach and shorts should be knee length.
etiquette.es: Que las mujeres vayan en topless es tabú, el traje de baño es solo para la playa y los pantalones cortos deben llegar a la rodilla.
etiquette.quote: Women going topless is taboo, and they should only wear swimwear at the beach. Shorts should be knee length.

etiquette.en: Shoes should be removed before entering a house.
etiquette.es: Hay que quitarse los zapatos antes de entrar a una casa.
etiquette.quote: Other simple things, such as removing shoes before entering a house (or, for that matter, budget accommodation), should be observed.

etiquette.en: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public except at bars or restaurants.
etiquette.es: Es ilegal beber alcohol en público salvo en bares o restaurantes.
etiquette.quote: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public except at bars or restaurants.

connectivity.en: Vodafone and Digicel SIM cards are sold at the airport, convenience stores and supermarkets, and must be registered if bought locally.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de Vodafone y Digicel se venden en el aeropuerto, tiendas y supermercados, y deben registrarse si se compran localmente.
connectivity.quote: You can buy Vodafone and Digicel SIM cards at the airport and at convenience stores and supermarkets. You must register your SIM card if you buy it locally.

connectivity.en: Phone coverage in rural areas and outlying islands can be limited or non-existent.
connectivity.es: La cobertura telefónica en zonas rurales e islas remotas puede ser limitada o inexistente.
connectivity.quote: Phone coverage in rural areas and outlying islands can be limited or non-existent.

connectivity.en: Remote parts of Upolu and Savaii mostly lack hotel wifi, so check in advance.
connectivity.es: En zonas remotas de Upolu y Savaii casi ningún hotel tiene wifi, así que conviene consultar antes.
connectivity.quote: check in advance with the hotel to make sure it has wifi. Most don't.

phrases.quote:
Hello.
Talofa. ("Greetings" is a closer translation.)

Fine, thank you.
Manuia, fa'afetai.
What is your name?
